prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn boolean_flags(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse comma-separated key=true or key=false records. Keys use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)* and must be unique. Reject empty input or malformed records. Return enabled keys in ASCII lexicographic order joined by commas; an all-false input returns the empty string.
Visible example: cache=true,trace=false,debug=true returns cache,debug.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: use std::collections::{HashMap,HashSet};fn key(s:&str)->bool{let p:Vec<_>=s.split('-').collect();!s.is_empty()&&s.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_lowercase()&&p.iter().all(|x|!x.is_empty()&&x.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_lowercase()||c.is_ascii_digit()))}pub fn boolean_flags(s:&str)->Option<String>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut d=HashMap::new();for r in s.split(','){let p:Vec<_>=r.split('=').collect();if p.len()!=2||!key(p[0])||(p[1]!="true"&&p[1]!="false")||d.insert(p[0],p[1]=="true").is_some(){return None}}let mut o:Vec<_>=d.into_iter().filter(|x|x.1).map(|x|x.0).collect();o.sort();Some(o.join(","))}
